description: The >>FLAG-85 migration-flagging directive - a compiler-directive WINDOW: introduced with the §2023:7.3 facility in COBOL-2002, classified obsolete by the 2014 standard and REMOVED in COBOL-2023. Annex E.2 item 21 ('Obsolete elements') is the removal record: 'The following features that were classified as obsolete in the previous COBOL standard, have been removed from this Working Draft International Standard: - FLAG-85 - FLAG-NATIVE-ARITHMETIC - Standard Arithmetic - ...', which fixes removedIn=2023 and, by 'classified as obsolete in the previous COBOL standard', obsoleteIn=2014. The 2023 text therefore carries NO general format for this directive and its OPERAND SYNTAX IS NOT DERIVABLE IN-REPO; the row gates the directive WORD, which is what the removal record supports. The introducedIn edge rides the same M2-catalog derivation as its sibling arithmetic-standard-2002 (Annex E.2 item 21's other leg; VCR row 28). Below 2002 the word is COBOL0900, at 2023 COBOL0902, at 2014 the COBOL0903 obsolete warning.
citation: Annex E.2 item 21 (removed in 2023, classified obsolete by the previous standard); the §2023:7.3 compiler-directive facility is a COBOL-2002 introduction (M2 catalog derivation, VCR Table 7 discipline)

directiveOperand.citation: Annex E.2 item 21 removed this directive in 2023, so the 2023 text carries no clause and its operand syntax is NOT derivable in-repo: the row gates the WORD, which is what the removal record supports. Content unchecked by decision, not by omission.

vcr: VCR row 28 (Annex E.2 item 21 removal) + the §2023:7.3 facility's 2002 introduction
source:
>>FLAG-85 ALL ON
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. PB725F8.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN.
           DISPLAY "X".
           STOP RUN.
